note: Independent re-judgment against RFC 5176 Section 3.3 and HEAD code (coa.go sendResponse, readCoAChange, sessionSelectorsMatch). TestRFC5176StateNeverChangesTheOutcome sends CoA-Requests with no State, rate-shaped State, session-ID-shaped State and Filter-Id-TLV-shaped State, asserting identical CoA-ACK, unchanged 10M rate change on session 20 and byte-equal echoed State. TestRFC5176StateIsNeverReadAsAChangeOrAnIdentity proves rate-shaped State without an authorization attribute gets CoA-NAK 401 and session-ID-shaped State beside an unknown Acct-Session-Id gets CoA-NAK 503, with zero events and State echoed. Termination-Action is refused with 401 so the second usage is unreachable.
